title: resources.rs slot-conflict tests assume unpinned schnorr48 IID hash ordering
description: Found by edge-case review of the 7ecb.3 repair (reviewer pass 3). rust/lichen-gateway/src/resources.rs:3198 (test rejected_conflicting_claim_moves_highwater_and_peer_claim_together) expects 0x89, which requires iid_from_pubkey(derive_keypair(seed 0x41)) > 0x0101010101010101 — a hard-coded dependency on unpinned SHA-512 output of the schnorr48 seed expansion. The adjacent test conflict_response_echoes_own_recorded_envelope (resources.rs:3246-3253) already has the sanctioned idiom: 'assign roles deterministically from the derived (hash) IIDs rather than assuming an ordering' (derive both IIDs, pick win/lose roles by slot::compare_iids at runtime). Not a correctness defect today — a seed-expansion change would fail the test loudly while production stays correct (false-negative test failure risk). Fix: rework the test to derive roles deterministically per the :3246 idiom. Same pattern may exist in other slot-conflict tests (lower_iid_peer_forces_complete_local_reallocation uses 0xff address tail, which is robust since derived IIDs clear the U/L bit -> byte0 <= 0xfd).
